dataset.name: NF-CSE-CIC-IDS2018
dataset.role: fresh target-development dataset with sealed confirmation partition

features.reduced_candidate_rationale: Pre-specified from the completed cross-external audit: remove duration, L7 protocol, and TCP flags as a bounded stability hypothesis. This is not a claim that those features caused the earlier failures.

split_protocol.group_definition: Categorical values exact; numeric values rounded to five significant digits across the eight endpoint-free features
split_protocol.group_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical grouped feature tuple
split_protocol.assignment_value: Unsigned first 64 bits of group SHA-256 divided by 2^64

development_sampling.reason: Bound local compute while retaining group-level deterministic sampling
development_sampling.method: A second deterministic SHA-256 group value selects groups within each development partition; all rows of a selected group remain together

split_protocol.sealed_confirmation_rule: The runner may count and hash confirmation groups during one-pass partition construction but must not compute predictions, labels by subgroup, metrics, plots, or candidate comparisons for confirmation rows.

candidate_experiments.model: Logistic Regression fitted on target_training only
Random Forest fitted on target_training only
Random Forest fitted on target_training only

evaluation.selection_scope: target_validation only after fitting on target_training and threshold selection on target_calibration
overfitting_checks: Random Forest out-of-bag score where available
comparison of full and reduced feature sets
evaluation.development_success_rule: A candidate is development-promising only if target-validation MCC and balanced accuracy each exceed the unchanged frozen-source Random Forest by at least 0.05. This does not establish generalisation until the sealed confirmation partition is evaluated under a later preregistered decision rule.

allowed: verify official row and label counts
prohibited_in_this_step: reuse NF-ToN-IoT or NF-BoT-IoT for model or threshold selection
change the split after reading candidate results
present development-validation performance as final external confirmation
